note: Each brand's own icon, as its homepage declares it (link rel=icon / apple-touch-icon, the web app manifest, or /apple-touch-icon.png and /favicon.ico on the same origin), harvested by scripts/harvest-brand-icons.mjs. Stored at web/public/<file>. source_url is the file the page pointed at; host is where it was served from. Rasters over 256px were scaled to 256 (source_width/source_height keep the original). Never Simple Icons, a favicon service, a platform default or a redrawing; a reference without a record shows no logo.
